title: Yummy Crispy Sweet Chinese Date-Night Bacon Fried-Rice
description: A whole30-friendly, date-night Chinese dish featuring streaky bacon and tempering chocolate, perfect for a special evening.

ingredients.name: Rice
ingredients.notes: preferably leftover Chinese-style street food rice, or substitute with cauliflower rice for whole30

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced bacon and cook until crispy, flipping occasionally.
Remove the cooked bacon from the pan and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the pan and swirl to coat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and stir-fry until fragrant.
Push the garlic-ginger mixture to one side of the pan, then pour in the beaten eggs.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, breaking them up with a spatula as they cook.
Mix the eggs with the garlic-ginger mixture.
Add the snow peas and diced red bell pepper to the pan and stir-fry until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cooked bacon back into the pan and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the tempering chocolate to the pan and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until melted and coated throughout the dish.
Season with coconut aminos and a pinch of salt to taste.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and garnish with sesame seeds and chopped scallions.
Serve immediately, with extra tempering chocolate on the side for drizzling.
